description: She wears a muted moss-green wool-textured long gown with a low square neckline, shaped bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow gold knotwork borders run around the neckline, cuffs, front opening and hem. Round bronze-toned brooches sit near both shoulders, and a flat patterned woven belt defines the waist. A cream linen-textured underdress is visible through the lower skirt opening. A green-and-brown plaid fringed shawl rests around her forearms. A brown leather shoe is visible at the front hem, while the second foot is largely concealed.
